title: Buracle Stack: the layer that brings your coding agents together
description: Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Oh My Pi, Qwen Code, Pi and AGY CLI get one setup, one shared memory, the same guards and workflows that end with proof.

hero.title: The layer that brings your coding agents together
hero.lede: Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Oh My Pi, Qwen Code, Pi and AGY CLI get one setup, one shared memory, the same guards and workflows that end with proof.
hero.orbitLabel: Seven coding agents on an orbit around one layer, Buracle Stack, with its MCP servers on the inner ring. Pick an agent to see how Buracle Stack plugs into it.

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.plugs: A plugin with skills, rules, review agents, MCP servers, command hooks and a status line.

harnesses.name: Codex CLI
harnesses.plugs: Command hooks in `hooks.json`, MCP servers in `config.toml`, an `AGENTS.md` block and exec policy rules.

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.plugs: Server and TUI plugins that run the shared hook pipeline inside OpenCode.

harnesses.name: Oh My Pi
harnesses.plugs: An omp plugin whose extension runs the hook pipeline in process.

harnesses.name: Qwen Code
harnesses.plugs: Hooks and MCP servers in `settings.json`, a `QWEN.md` block, path rules, review agents and commands.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.plugs: An extension for the hooks, an `AGENTS.md` block and MCP servers in `mcp.json`.

harnesses.name: AGY CLI
harnesses.plugs: Command hooks in `hooks.json`, MCP servers in `mcp_config.json` and a plugin with rules and review agents.

memory.title: One brain, shared by every agent
body: A decision you make in Codex CLI is there when Claude Code starts the next session. Each project has its own brain, and the person brain keeps what holds in every project.
Memories cite the files they are about, so `memory_search` with `files:` finds every memory about a file. The Console draws the same network: press `G` there.
memory.example: An example brain, invented for this page
memory.label: An example brain seen from above: the project brain on the left, the person brain on the right. Each bright node is a memory. Select one to read it.
memory.listLabel: Read the example memories as a list

memories.title: Totals are computed in cents, never in floats
sumItems stopped one item early: the loop bound was items.length - 1
CSV exports stream rows instead of building the file in memory
Next.js cache tags: unstable_cache with tags, then revalidateTag
Release: pnpm build, pnpm test, then tag the version
Finance reads the reports every Monday at 09:00 UTC
Commit messages in the imperative, under 60 characters
Reply in Turkish, keep code and commits in English
Run the type checker before every commit
On Apple silicon, Homebrew lives in /opt/homebrew, not /usr/local

loops.title: Workflows that loop until the work is proven
loops.sub: Each workflow writes down what it will do, starts every behavior change with a failing test, gets an independent review and ends only when the result is proven.
loops.footnote: In /plan-build and /goal-build a stop guard keeps the turn open until the plan is VERIFIED. Say stop, wait or hold on to pause.

items.when: You want a reviewed plan approved before any code.

loopBack.text: A failed check adds fix tasks and goes back to Build.

items.example: /plan-build add CSV export to the reports page

items.when: The end state is clear and the path is found by building.

loopBack.text: Failing criteria become the next round's tasks.

items.example: /goal-build search p95 under 200 ms on the seed data

items.when: One behavior is broken and you want proof it is fixed.

phases.name: RED test that fails for the reported reason

loopBack.text: A test that passes before the fix means the root cause is wrong: back to Investigate.

items.example: /bugfix invoice total skips the last line item

items.when: The problem or the scope is still unclear.
items.example: /requirements saved searches for the reports page
